authority: Paper only. No live orders, transfers, borrowing or commitments. Any real-money step is the human's decision.

evidence.note: The account may be checked at any time; peeking does not inflate the false-positive rate.

core.hypothesis: H3: volatility-managed index exposure beats buy-and-hold on NAV per unit
core.price_source: FRED series SP500: S&P 500 index daily close, price only (no dividends in either arm), published about one day late
core.target_weight: min(1, vol_target^2 / realized_var), realized_var = annualized variance of the last 21 daily log returns
core.fill: orders decided on data through close t fill at the next close seen by a later run
core.benchmark: same contributions, always 100% invested, same fills and costs
core.e_value: strategy NAV per unit / benchmark NAV per unit
core.reject_if: e-value of the reverse bet (benchmark/strategy) reaches 20, or 10 years pass without the strategy reaching 20

kalshi.hypothesis: H1: resting maker bids on the favorite side of Kalshi contracts earn positive net returns

order.price: best bid on the favorite side + 1 cent, if still below the ask
order.selection: earliest close time first, then ticker

kalshi.fill_rule: filled only if a trade prints strictly through our price on our side between placement and expiry (queue position assumed last)
kalshi.fee: maker fee ceil(0.0175 * C * P * (1-P)) in cents per order, charged as if maker fees apply to every series
kalshi.settlement: pay 1 dollar per contract if the market result equals our side; voided markets refund cost and fee
kalshi.e_value: product over settlement batches of mean_i (1 + lambda * (Y_i / q_eff_i - 1)), q_eff = price + fee per contract
kalshi.batching_reason: averaging within a batch keeps the factor's expectation at most 1 under the null whatever the dependence between contracts
kalshi.reject_if: after 3,000 settled filled contracts the 95% CI of net return per dollar lies below +0.5 cents, or 18 months pass without e-value 20

changes: core prices from FRED SP500 instead of stooq SPY
kalshi: spread at most 5 cents; one order per event; multivariate combos excluded; 1-7 days to close instead of 1-30; up to 100 new orders per run; fills counted only inside the order's 24-hour life
amendments.reason: stooq resets connections from this environment; the first live market scan showed parlay combos and favorites quoted as wide as 6c bid / 94c ask, where 'bid + 1 cent' is a deep bid filled mainly when the outcome is already decided against it, not the favorite-side maker the hypothesis describes; a full 1-30 day scan exceeded 60,000 markets per run
